# Cash Ready Homes Hudson Valley

> Local cash home buyer serving the Hudson Valley, New York. We buy houses as-is for cash, with New York attorney and title closings, no realtor commissions, and a timeline you choose.

## Business
- Name: Cash Ready Homes Hudson Valley
- Founder: Jack
- What we do: Cash home buyer (as-is purchases). Fair cash offers, typically within 24 hours. Closings coordinated with New York real estate attorneys and title companies.

- Service area (no storefront address): Westchester, Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, and Ulster Counties, NY
